title: OFSCP POST /api/groups/{groupId}/join request body (v0.1)
description: Optional body of a group join (§5.7). The body may be absent (not validated); a JSON body, possibly empty ({}), is validated against this schema when the join would record a request (`request` policy, caller not a member) and ignored otherwise. A provider may enforce its own maximum length for `message`.

message.description: Optional note from the requester, stored as JoinRequest.message. Never null.
